headline: Choosing an Emergency Plumber: What to Look For
articleBody:
When plumbing goes sideways and you need help fast, choosing the right emergency plumber can make all the difference. You're probably stressed, but taking a moment to consider a few things can save you a lot of headaches later. First off, always check for current local licensing and insurance. This isn't just paperwork; it means they're qualified and you're protected if anything goes wrong. CG Plumbing Solutions, for instance, is a licensed and insured company (Nevada License C-1D/0093216) serving the entire Las Vegas Valley. Next, ask about their availability and response time. A 24/7 emergency plumber should be able to give you an estimated arrival window, not just a vague 'we'll be there.' It's also super important to get clear on pricing. Reputable companies will provide written options and won't have surprise charges. We believe in showing you the scope of work and explaining the costs before we start anything. Don't forget to inquire about warranties on their work and parts. This gives you peace of mind that they stand behind their service. Finally, think about their service area; you want a local company that knows the nuances of plumbing in places like Las Vegas, Henderson, or Summerlin. Choosing a qualified, transparent, and local professional like CG Plumbing Solutions ensures you're getting dependable workmanship when you need it most. 

### Questions to Ask Before You Decide
Before making a decision, ask if they are licensed and insured (and ask for their license number), what their estimated arrival time is, if they provide written estimates, and what their warranty covers. These questions ensure you're hiring a reputable and reliable professional for your emergency plumbing needs.
